answer: Commit-reveal with auditors splits the process. Each identity yields a receipt by solving a modulus-hard vault puzzle, verified by a ferrous token burned per head. The atlas of auditors rotates every epoch; fakes must re-solve puzzles for each, as tokens are serialized with anti-coordinate timelocks. Cost: per-Sybil token loss and a 4.2-minute ledger-check delay, unbounded by computing hardware.
